[BIL-04] Failed payments and dunning
A failed payment triggers three retries over 10 days. The account stays fully active during that window and is downgraded to read-only on day 11, never deleted. Data is retained for 90 days after downgrade.

[BIL-01] Refund window
Refunds are available within 30 days of the charge date. Requests after 30 days are declined, with a one-time exception available for annual plans cancelled within 45 days. Approved refunds land in 5-7 business days and always return to the original payment method; we cannot refund to a different card.

[BIL-02] Duplicate charges
Duplicate charges are usually a pending authorisation, not a second capture, and drop off on their own within 3 business days. If two charges have both settled, support reverses the later one immediately without needing manager approval.

[BIL-03] Plan changes and proration
Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated for the remainder of the cycle. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal date; we do not issue partial refunds for a mid-cycle downgrade. Customers keep paid-tier features until renewal.

[BIL-05] Invoices and tax documents
Invoices are self-serve under Settings > Billing > Invoices, downloadable as PDF for the last 24 months. VAT/GST numbers can be added retroactively and the invoice reissued once. Support cannot alter the billed entity name on a settled invoice; that requires a credit note plus reissue, which takes 2 business days.
